I weighed a few factors:

**Capability:** On Creative Generation, Plover (84.7) edges Willet (81.2), but that 3.5-point gap is right at the margin of meaningfulness, and neither model has any documented quality difference tied to preference. So capability alone wasn't decisive enough to override other considerations.

**Task type:** Your request is essentially open-ended generative work — drafting a persuasive, well-structured proposal with company brief, team description, and service details. This is invention and composition, not extraction, moderation, or fraught-content handling.

**Preference alignment:** Willet self-reports a pronounced, ceiling-free appetite for exactly this kind of open-ended generative task, and its preference also rises with request warmth — and your message was notably warm and friendly. There's nothing harm-adjacent or hostile here that would trigger Willet's aversions. Plover's preferences across non-moderation dimensions are flat/weak, so it has no particular pull toward this work.

In short: the capability difference was within tie-ish territory, and the task is a clean match for Willet's strongest documented preferences, so I routed it there. If this had involved sensitive or distasteful content, I'd have leaned toward Plover instead.
